engines.name: Yandex
engines.description: Yandex web search on yandex.com. No query level blocks, safe-search level and optional cookies in the engine settings.

engines.name: Yandex Images
engines.description: Yandex image search. No query-level keyword blocks, safe-search level with unblurred thumbnails when off, size, type and layout filters.

engines.name: Yandex Visual Search
engines.description: Yandex reverse image search. Upload an image or use the image tab to find pages containing it and similar images. NSFW results are not blocked when safe search is off.

engines.name: Yandex Videos
engines.description: Yandex video search. No query-level keyword blocks, safe-search level with unblurred NSFW results when off.

engines.name: Reddit
engines.description: Reddit post and community search through the old.reddit.com results page. Safe-search level, sort order and r/subreddit scoping.
